description: A written T is an original token. The written route of [T B] reads it and its suffix as in the main parse, so the chosen a survives, and the check passes (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T B]
%rule b A [T B] [T B]
%rule c A T
